This one’s a perfect example of good advice… explained terribly.

There’s a LinkedIn video going around about things recruiters don’t want to see on your resume, and honestly — most of it is right. It just needs context.

So in this video, we go through it and explain why things like objectives, full addresses, random skills, and even hobbies can actually hurt you early on.

Because your resume isn’t your life story — it’s just there to get you to the next step.
title: RECRUITER CRASHING OUT OVER RESUMES
